accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.web.screen-reader: Initial HTML exposes the same headings, landmarks, names, states, relationships, claims, limitations, and actions to a screen reader as the visible page.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.web.zoom-200: At 200 percent zoom, content and controls remain readable, operable, complete, and free from obstructive overlap.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.web.reflow-400: At 400 percent reflow, primary meaning and actions remain available without two-dimensional scrolling except for intrinsically two-dimensional content.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.web.reduced-motion: Reduced-motion and failed-observer states expose the stable final content and preserve every task and deep-link target.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.app.browser.keyboard: In the browser runtime, every task control and state transition is keyboard operable with logical focus order and no keyboard trap.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.app.browser.screen-reader: In the browser runtime, headings, landmarks, control names, permissions, progress, results, errors, and recovery are programmatically exposed and announced.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.app.browser.touch: In the browser runtime, every direct touch control meets the governed target size and remains operable without precision gestures.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.app.browser.state-recovery: In the browser runtime, interrupted, failed, denied, expired, revoked, and cancelled states preserve recoverable input and expose an understandable next step.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.app.browser.zoom-200: At 200 percent browser zoom, task content and controls remain readable, operable, complete, and free from obstructive overlap.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.app.browser.reflow-400: At 400 percent browser reflow, the complete task and recovery path remain available without two-dimensional scrolling except for intrinsically two-dimensional content.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.app.browser.reduced-motion: In the browser runtime, reduced-motion and failed-observer states preserve task state, causality, progress, and the same reachable final result.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.app.native.keyboard: In the declared native runtime, every keyboard-supported task control and state transition follows platform focus order without a trap.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.app.native.accessibility-a: In the declared native runtime, task structure, control names, permissions, progress, results, errors, and recovery are exposed through the platform accessibility API and announced.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.app.native.touch: In the declared native runtime, every direct touch control meets the governed platform target size and remains operable without precision gestures.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.app.native.state-recovery: In the declared native runtime, interrupted, failed, denied, expired, revoked, cancelled, backgrounded, restored, and view-disposed states preserve recoverable input, semantic native-view order, platform accessibility traversal order, and an understandable next step.

accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.app.native.reduced-motion: In the declared native runtime, reduced-motion and interrupted-transition states preserve task state, causality, progress, and the same reachable final result.

accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.document.links: Every document link and cross-reference has a descriptive label and resolves to its declared destination.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.document.thai-latin: Thai and Latin text remains readable, selectable, correctly ordered, and free of missing or substituted glyphs.

accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.pdf.tags-order: PDF tags, heading hierarchy, and reading order preserve the intended content sequence without duplicate or orphaned meaningful content.
accessibilityFixtureCriteria.accessibility.pdf.alternatives: Meaningful images, figures, tables, and data in the PDF have accurate alternatives or proximate equivalents.

currentMeaning.none: The destination is not the current route/page or current in-page location.
currentMeaning.page: The route destination identifies the current page; exactly one is required for a non-empty interactive navigation model.
currentMeaning.location: The anchor destination identifies the current in-page location; at most one exists and an interactive side bookmark requires exactly one.

componentContractTemplates.resolution: An artifact-resolved implementation record may copy a component contract only from its exact format/runtime reference record or from one exact-format template below. Unknown component IDs, cross-format templates, and caller-authored substitutes block promotion.

contract.purpose: Project stable page headings into one heading-derived table of contents while keeping ecosystem, property, and external destinations in a separate related-destination group.
contract.nonPurpose: It is not global navigation, a browser side rail, a disclosure widget, or a current-location indicator.
contract.contentContract: Use at least two real locale-labelled page-local heading anchors in source heading order with exact IDs and targets; never mix global or related destinations into the table of contents.

default.behavior: The heading-derived table of contents is readable, complete, and ordered like the document headings.

hover.behavior: The static document contract does not depend on pointer hover.

focus.behavior: The source document preserves descriptive links and native reading order without manufacturing browser focus behavior.

activePressed.behavior: The static document contract does not manufacture a pressed state.

selectedCurrent.behavior: A static document table of contents does not invent a live current-location state.

disabled.behavior: Broken or unavailable heading anchors block validation instead of becoming disabled entries.

loading.behavior: All indexed headings exist before the document is emitted.

empty.behavior: The table of contents is omitted when fewer than two useful heading anchors remain.

error.behavior: Broken heading anchors fail validation rather than becoming a visible component state.

success.behavior: Following a document cross-reference is not a success state.

formatBehavior.behavior: Use a native heading-derived table of contents with descriptive cross-references; emit global and related destinations separately.

accessibility.name: The table of contents has an exact locale-specific heading or accessible name.
accessibility.role: Use native document headings, lists, and descriptive cross-references.
accessibility.value: No current-location or expanded browser state is exposed.
accessibility.order: Entry order exactly matches source heading order and native reading order.
accessibility.status: Every table-of-contents entry resolves to its declared heading target.

contract.evidencePermissionBoundary: The page index provides orientation only and never changes claim scope, evidence authority, or permission.
antiPatterns: Browser side rail in a document
Global routes mixed into the table of contents

contract.purpose: Project stable page headings into heading-derived PDF bookmarks while keeping ecosystem, property, and external destinations in a separate related-destination group.
contract.nonPurpose: It is not global navigation, a browser side rail, a disclosure widget, or a current-location indicator.
contract.contentContract: Use at least two real locale-labelled page-local heading anchors in source heading order with exact IDs and targets; never mix global or related destinations into PDF bookmarks.

default.behavior: PDF bookmarks are readable, complete, and ordered like the tagged source headings.

hover.behavior: The fixed PDF contract does not depend on browser pointer hover.

focus.behavior: The PDF preserves descriptive link annotations and tag order without manufacturing browser focus behavior.

activePressed.behavior: The fixed PDF contract does not manufacture a pressed state.

selectedCurrent.behavior: Static PDF bookmarks do not invent a live current-location state.

disabled.behavior: Broken or unavailable bookmark targets block validation instead of becoming disabled entries.

loading.behavior: All bookmark targets exist before the PDF is emitted.

empty.behavior: PDF bookmarks are omitted when fewer than two useful heading anchors remain.

error.behavior: Broken PDF bookmark targets fail validation rather than becoming a visible component state.

success.behavior: Following a PDF bookmark is not a success state.

formatBehavior.behavior: Use heading-derived PDF bookmarks and tagged link annotations; emit global and related destinations separately.

accessibility.name: The PDF bookmark index has exact locale-specific labels.
accessibility.role: Use heading-derived bookmarks and descriptive tagged links.
accessibility.value: No current-location or expanded browser state is exposed.
accessibility.order: Bookmark order exactly matches source heading and tag order.
accessibility.status: Every PDF bookmark resolves to its declared heading target.

contract.evidencePermissionBoundary: The page index provides orientation only and never changes claim scope, evidence authority, or permission.
antiPatterns: Browser side rail in a PDF
Global routes mixed into PDF bookmarks

contract.purpose: Project stable page headings into heading-derived deck section markers while keeping ecosystem, property, and external destinations in a separate opening or closing related-destination group.
contract.nonPurpose: It is not global navigation, a browser side rail, a disclosure widget, or a current-location indicator.
contract.contentContract: Use at least two real locale-labelled page-local heading anchors in source section order with exact IDs and targets; never mix global or related destinations into section markers.

default.behavior: Section markers are readable, complete, and ordered like the governed slide sections.

hover.behavior: The presentation contract does not depend on pointer hover.

focus.behavior: The deck preserves slide-object and accessibility order without manufacturing browser focus behavior.

activePressed.behavior: The presentation contract does not manufacture a pressed state.

selectedCurrent.behavior: Static section markers do not invent a live current-location state.

disabled.behavior: Broken or unavailable section targets block validation instead of becoming disabled entries.

formatBehavior.behavior: Use heading-derived section markers; emit global and related destinations in a separate opening or closing group.

accessibility.value: No current-location or expanded browser state is exposed.
accessibility.order: Marker order exactly matches governed slide-section and accessibility order.

overlays.configRefContract: Build Card capabilityConfigRefs.map resolves an object containing every requiredFields entry.
testMatrix: geography boundary coverage grain time unit projection claim evidence rights attribution schema and export receipt are declared
no-data out-of-scope and low-confidence states remain distinct without color alone and preserve the bounded spatial meaning
map units carry one of the five value states and the legend shows every present state; dark classes are derived; no class anchor sits in a retired hue window

interactive: keyboard, screen reader, touch, focus, selected, pan, zoom, and reset states expose the same bounded meaning as the visual map
loading, empty, partial, error, restored, and unavailable-layer states preserve boundary, coverage, source, and material limitations
static: the final static map and its proximate non-spatial alternative expose the same bounded meaning without selected, focus, pan, or zoom affordances
native document structure, PDF tags, slide reading order, or social feed-size fixture preserves geography, legend, source, uncertainty, and material limitations

overlays.fallback: labelled static map plus a non-spatial summary or table

identity.web_public: role-approved identity asset in the header, or governed live-text identity when no approved logo role exists
identity.app_interactive: role-approved identity asset in the app header, or governed live-text identity when no approved logo role exists
identity.document_flow: role-approved identity asset, or governed text identity in native document text
identity.pdf_fixed: role-approved identity asset, or governed text identity preserved as tagged or extractable text
identity.deck_presentation: role-approved identity asset, or governed text identity on the title and closing slides
identity.social_static: role-approved channel-safe identity asset, or governed text identity; never reconstruct a logo

navigation.document_flow: ecosystem and property routes plus external destinations in a related-destination group separate from the page index
navigation.pdf_fixed: ecosystem and property routes plus external destinations in a related-destination group separate from PDF bookmarks
navigation.deck_presentation: ecosystem and property routes plus external destinations in an opening or closing related-destination group separate from section markers
navigation.social_static: not applicable; preserve a single destination cue

sideBookmark.web_public: anchored page index that moves into the mobile disclosure
sideBookmark.app_interactive: task or section index only when stable useful sections exist
sideBookmark.document_flow: heading-derived page index represented only as the table of contents
sideBookmark.pdf_fixed: heading-derived page index represented only as PDF bookmarks and visible contents
sideBookmark.deck_presentation: heading-derived page index represented only as the agenda or section-progress markers

primaryCTA.web_public: typed destination binding rendered as a direct control
primaryCTA.app_interactive: typed destination binding rendered as a direct control with result recovery and receipt when consequential
primaryCTA.document_flow: typed destination binding rendered as a working link or explicit instruction
primaryCTA.pdf_fixed: typed destination binding rendered as a working link with visible destination or explicit instruction
primaryCTA.deck_presentation: typed destination binding rendered as a working link with visible destination, verified QR with text, or explicit instruction
primaryCTA.social_static: typed route, external, download, form, or contact destination rendered as one specific destination cue

motion.web_public: role-gated enhancement with visible source and reduced-motion final state
motion.app_interactive: state and causality feedback with reduced-motion final state
motion.document_flow: static final state and structural sequence
motion.pdf_fixed: static final state and structural sequence
motion.deck_presentation: static final state by default; presenter animation only when sequence meaning requires it
motion.social_static: static final state; no motif, overlay or animated identity on OG or feed creatives

evidence.web_public: visible disclosure linked to stable claim and source records
evidence.app_interactive: in-context disclosure linked to stable claim and source records
evidence.document_flow: source note footnote or endnote plus evidence appendix when needed
evidence.pdf_fixed: source note footnote or endnote plus evidence appendix when needed
evidence.deck_presentation: compact slide cue plus source appendix
evidence.social_static: compact evidence cue plus durable destination

receipt.web_public: runtime success error and reference state
receipt.app_interactive: runtime result recovery and durable receipt proportional to consequence
receipt.document_flow: audience-relevant document version or source record; internal production receipt remains in the artifact manifest
receipt.pdf_fixed: final-byte validation recorded in the internal artifact manifest; expose only audience-relevant version or source metadata
receipt.deck_presentation: audience-relevant version or source slide; internal production receipt remains in the artifact manifest
receipt.social_static: publication sidecar kept outside the audience creative

interfaceIcon.web_public: approved outline rounded icon rendered with FILL 0 and accessible name through its control
interfaceIcon.app_interactive: approved outline rounded icon rendered with FILL 0 and accessible name through its control
interfaceIcon.document_flow: approved vector or embedded glyph with text equivalent and font-safe export
interfaceIcon.pdf_fixed: outlined or embedded vector with text equivalent
interfaceIcon.deck_presentation: editable approved vector or font-safe embedded glyph with text equivalent
interfaceIcon.social_static: outlined approved vector; never substitute an interface icon for a logo
